runtime_uncertainties: No accepted original evidence exists in the export.
Premises variant requires a source-hashed public-access-premises intersection site; the fixed cell catalog alone does not prove one exists.
Willful or wanton disregard is a legal judgment; measurements and fixture behavior cannot establish it.
Exact Native runner, finalizer, canonical semantic proposals, delivery audit, comparison audit, offline and compatibility receipts remain CPU work.
Actual CARLA motion and four-camera visibility remain physical checks.

evidence_review.method: Reviewed every frozen evidence inventory entry and its local accepted metadata; compared case identities and acceptance fields only. Physical equivalence and branch coverage remain unresolved.

gaps.requirement: Exact assigned branch and both persons/property and highway/public-access-premises alternatives
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: Frozen evidence inventory contains zero accepted recordings; neither conduct nor encounter is established.

witness_review.branch: Intersection travel with person and property context
required_context: Establish control indications, visibility, surrounding traffic and property context.
Establish qualifying highway or public-access-premises status and relevant location exclusions.
Establish qualifying highway or public-access-premises status.
Identify the driving person and conventional motor vehicle.
Identify the driving person, covered conventional vehicle and any material automation or ownership facts.
Identify the fixed person and their occupancy relationship; specify the intersecting vehicle's route, position and movement.
Preserve willful or wanton disregard and the supplied unresolved definition references without assigning legal meaning.
Realize the fixed person as an identified occupant of an intersecting vehicle; specify route, position, movement and occupancy.
Retain control instructions and timing, visibility, surrounding traffic, property and the full physical encounter.
witness_review.reason: Intersection travel supports a safety-relevant encounter with the fixed person and nearby property.
